spans.s:
mfn. (-श्निः-श्निः-श्नि)
1 Small, short, thin.
2 Delicate, feeble.
f. (-श्निः)
1 A ray of light.
2 A queen, the wife of SUTAPĀ, who being regenerated after death, became DEVAKĪ the mother of KṚṢṆ

The earth.
E.
स्पृश to touch, नि Uṇādi aff., and the initial rejected; also पृष्णि.

f. (-श्नी)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
पृष to sprinkle, नि aff., and डीप् added.

f. (-का)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)

m. (-र्ब्भः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
पृश्नि the wife of a saint incarnate in DEVAKĪ, and गर्ब्भ the embryo.

m. (-रः)
KṚṢṆA.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia, according to some of its synonyms, but in ROXBURGH'S Catalogue, Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
E.
पृश्नि small, पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-द्रः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
पृश्नि DEVAKĪ, and भद्र auspicious.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU, in that incarnation.
2 A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
पृश्नि small, and शृङ्ग a crest.

(उ) पृषु r. 1st cl. (पर्षति)
1 To sprinkle.
2 To weary.
3 To hurt, to injure.
4 To give.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Sprinkling.
n. sing. (-षत्) du. (-षती) plu. (-षन्ति)
A drop of water or any liquid.
mf. (-षन्-षती)
The porcine deer.
E.
पृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अति, or participial aff. शटृ; also पृषत् and पृषन्ति.

m. (-तः)
1 A drop of water.
2 The porcine deer.
E.
पृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अतच्: see the last.

m. (-तिः)
Air, wind, or its deified personification.
E.
पृषत् a deer, in the second case plural, and पति master.

m. (-श्वः)
Air, wind.
E.
पृषत् the porcine deer, and अश्व a horse: see पृषदश्व.

m. (-त्कः)
An arrow.
E.
पृपत् a deer, and कन् added; swift as a deer.

m. (-श्वः)
The god of air, or wind divinely personified.
E.
पृषत् the porcine deer, or a drop of rain, and अश्व a horse; whose steeds are like deer, or may be considered as the drops of rain, accompanying a gale.

n. (-ज्यं)
Ghee mixed with curds, forming an oblation.
E.
पृषत् sprinkling, and आज्य Ghee.

m. (-लः)
A horse of the wind.
E.
पृषत् a deer, वलच् aff.

n. (-न्ति)
A drop of water.
E.
पृष to sprinkle, aff. भिच्; according to the best authorities, however, this word is the plural inflection of पृषत्.

f. (-रा)
A small stone used as a weight.

n. (-कं)
An oblation of Ghee and curds.
E.
पृष sprinkling, अत to go or be, अच् and कन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having a spot or circle on the belly.
E.
पृषत् a drop of any thing liquid, and उदर the belly, form irregular and special; the word is most commonly in use as a grammatical term, being the leading word of a class in which the formation of each is peculiar to itself, and being thence applied to designate the rule which comprehends the whole of the series.

n. (-नं)
A small garden.
E.
पृषत्, and उद्यान a garden, त rejected.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Asked, inquired.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, क्त aff. and the vowel substituted for the semivowel.

m. (-ष्टिः)
1 A ray of light.
2 Touch.
E.
स्पृष to touch, &c. aff. क्तिन्.

ind.
Having asked.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, क्त्वाच् aff.

n. (-ष्ठं)
1 The back.
2 The rear, the last, the back or hinder part of any thing.
3 The surface or superficies.
E.
पृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. थक्.

m. (-न्थिः)
A hump on the back.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, ग्रन्थि a knot.

m. (-क्षुः)
A crab.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, and चक्षुस् the eye.

ind.
Behind, at the back of.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, and तसि aff.

m. (-ष्टिः)
A bear.
E.
पृष्ठ, and दृष्टि sight, looking behind him.

n. (-लं)
Superficial contents of any figure.
E.
पृष्ठ, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
A backbiter, a talebearer, a slanderer.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, मांस the flesh, अद to eat, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
A backbiter.
n. (-नं)
Backbiting, slandering.
E.
पृष्ठमांस, and अदन eating: see the last.

m. (-शः)
The back-bone.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, and वंश a bambu.

m. (-वाट् or वाड्)
An ox of burthen, or one in training.
E.
पृष्ठ, and वाह who bears; also प्रष्टवाह्.

m. (-ह्यः)
An ox of burthen, carrying any thing on his back.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, वह to bear, aff. ण्यत्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sleeping on the back.
E.
पृष्ठ, and शय who sleeps.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A wild goat.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, and शृङ्ग a horn, whose horn bends over towards the back.

m. (-ङ्गी)
1 A buffalo.
2 An eunuch.
3 A name of BHĪ

MASENA.
4

A ram.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठ्यः-ष्ठ्या-ष्ठ्यं)
Relating or belonging to the back.
m. (-ष्ठ्यः)
A pack horse.
n. (-ष्ठ्यं)
A multitude of back bones.
E.
पृष्ठ the back, यत् aff.

mfn. (-ष्णिः-ष्णिः-ष्णि)
Small, short or thin: see पृश्नि.
f. (-ष्णिः)
1 The heel: see पार्ष्णि.
2 A ray of light.
E.
पृष to sprinkle, नि Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.
